verdict.rationale: Auth0's docs state users can log in with social accounts such as Facebook or X, and that Universal Login supports social, enterprise, and custom identity providers across a wide range of login methods. Per-organization connections and federated login flows indicate providers are set up as tenant connections rather than built by hand. missing for 10: an enumerated broad catalog of social/OAuth providers beyond Facebook and X, explicit documentation that adding a provider is dashboard/config-only with no code, independent hands-on corroboration specific to social provider setup.
